title: saxifraga nervosa subsp. intricata
intro: Saxifraga nervosa subsp. intricata, commonly known as Nerve Root or Nerve Stem Saxifrage, is a plant species belonging to the Saxifragaceae family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, due to its calming effects. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga nervosa subsp. intricata are attributed to its ability to act as a nervine, sedative, and anxiolytic, which helps to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
